family.description: MafB constitutes a family of secreted toxins in pathogenic Neisseria species, probably involved in interbacterial competition [[cite:PUB00073618]]. Genes immediately downstream of mafB encode a specific immunity protein (MafI). MafB proteins exhibit a signal peptide sequence, a N-terminal conserved domain and a C-terminal variable region. Toxic domains identified at the C terminus include [pfam:PF15542], [pfam:PF14437], [pfam:PF15524], and [pfam:PF14436].
family.name: Neisseria toxin MafB
